comments.author: Visitor
comments.body: The maps on this database list landmarks that serve as gateways to other areas, like Cusco, with the area's name instead of the landmark's designation. It's useful for when you want to know where to find said entrances, but it can be a bit confusing when a quest guide does not specify if a landmark isn't shown on the map.
